office_does: The sheriff runs the Walla Walla County Sheriff's Office, the county's law enforcement agency, which patrols, investigates and enforces state and local law.
race_blurb: Sheriff Mark Crider is retiring, so the seat is open. Chief Deputy Richard Schram, endorsed by Crider and the deputies' association, faces Deputy Ashley Daschofsky, who says the command staff has failed to stop turnover. Both prefer the Republican Party; Schram led the primary 61.9% to 36.9%.

candidates.summary: Chief deputy of the Walla Walla County Sheriff's Office, with 23 years at the office and eight in command, endorsed by the retiring sheriff and the deputies' association.
highlights: Rose from corrections deputy to chief deputy; SWAT commander and FBI National Academy graduate [S1][S5]
Calls the constrained budget and uncompetitive wages the office's critical issue [S5]
Promises 'disciplined budgeting' and community-oriented policing with foot patrols [S3]
Says the office will not carry out missions to detain people for ICE [S5]
Endorsed by Sheriff Crider, the Commissioned Deputies Association (22-0) and IAFF Local 404 [S2][S4]

experience.basis: Command-staff insider who runs on 23 years at the office, continuity with the retiring sheriff and the deputies' endorsement; he has never held elected office.

safety.basis: Promises to uphold the law and keep residents safe through visible, proactive deputies and community policing; conventional enforcement, not hardline.

spending.basis: Pledges every budget request will rest on real operational needs and every dollar be 'clearly justified'.

candidates.summary: Walla Walla County deputy since 2016, Marine Corps veteran and K9 handler, six-time state DUI enforcement award winner, running to replace the office's command staff.
highlights: Says the office has lost employees as fast as it hires them and command staff has failed to fix it [S3]
Would cut command positions and fund victim advocates and code enforcement [S1][S3]
Promises proactive, intelligence-led policing and public reporting on crime and use of force [S2]
Would limit help to ICE to stopping violence [S3]
On the Prosecuting Attorney's impeachment-disclosure list over statements to a co-worker, which he disputes [S4]

experience.basis: Runs repeatedly on 'a change at the command staff level' against the current leadership, though he is a 10-year deputy of the same office.

safety.basis: Enforcement-oriented record and platform (DUI enforcement, proactive policing, 'holding criminals accountable'), adding victim advocates and code enforcement.
